skills.name: document
skills.description: Use to orchestrate a complete Diátaxis documentation workflow from survey and planning through iterative document implementation and refinement.

skills.name: explanation
skills.description: Write Diátaxis-compliant explanation documentation that deepens understanding through context, reasoning, and conceptual discussion.
skills.description_zh: 编写符合Diátaxis的解释文档，通过背景、推理和概念讨论深化理解。

skills.name: how-to-guide
skills.description: Write a Diátaxis-compliant how-to guide focused on helping competent users accomplish a specific real-world task or solve a specific problem
skills.description_zh: 编写符合Diátaxis的操作指南，帮助有基础的用户完成具体任务或解决问题。

skills.name: reference
skills.description: Write Diátaxis-compliant reference documentation that describes the machinery clearly, accurately, and neutrally.
skills.description_zh: 编写符合Diátaxis的参考文档，清晰、准确、中立地说明系统机制。

skills.name: survey
skills.description: Use when surveying a codebase and planning a complete documentation system using the Diátaxis framework
skills.description_zh: 调研代码库并使用Diátaxis规划完整文档体系。

skills.name: tutorial
skills.description: Write beginner-focused software tutorials that teach one thing well through a reproducible, step-by-step workflow.
skills.description_zh: 编写面向初学者的软件教程，通过可复现分步流程教好一个主题。

skills.name: write-doc
skills.description: Validate one planned Diátaxis document context and route it to the correct specialised writer for tutorial, how-to guide, reference, or explanation documentation.
skills.description_zh: 验证单份已规划Diátaxis文档的上下文，转交教程、操作指南、参考或解释专门作者。
